products.name: Software License Compliance & Audit-Defense (Effective License Position) — Commercial
products.short_description: Build a defensible Effective License Position and audit-readiness posture — reconcile entitlements against deployment, close gaps before they're found, and walk into any audit with the numbers in hand. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Know your true license position before a vendor auditor does

A software audit letter shouldn't trigger a fire drill. Without an Effective License Position (ELP) — entitlements reconciled against actual deployment — you can't prove compliance, and shortfalls become expensive settlements. This solution builds a defensible ELP and audit-readiness posture: reconcile what you own against what you run, close gaps before they're found, and walk into any audit with the numbers already in hand.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what an Effective License Position is, the entitlement ↔ deployment reconciliation model, common compliance gaps, and the audit-defense posture.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (entitlement system of record, deployment/usage discovery, product use rights, a reconciliation method, owner sign-off) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: gather entitlements and proofs of purchase, collect deployment/usage, normalize and reconcile to an ELP, identify and close gaps, assemble the audit package, then pilot, validate, and expand to more publishers.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — deployment discovery, entitlement-vs-deployment reconciliation validation, an ELP and gap report, safe remediation of over-deployment, and a reconciliation-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A defensible Effective License Position — entitlements reconciled to deployment, gaps closed, and an audit package ready — so a vendor audit holds no surprises, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • LICCOMP-Discovery.ps1 — collect a deployment/usage inventory for the in-scope product
    • LICCOMP-Remediation.ps1 — safely reclaim clear over-deployment (stale/disabled-user assignments)
    • LICCOMP-Report.ps1 — produce the Effective License Position summary and the gap list
    • LICCOMP-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the reconciliation-scope group for an in-scope product
    • LICCOMP-Validation.ps1 — confirm the entitlement and deployment inputs are reconcilable

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
